disagreements.title: Booking wait and slot loading show no visible progress
disagreements.a_reason: The first-stated harm is that Book shows no progress for 1.5 s (only an unstyled aria-busy), which is D09. The second half, slot loading where Next returns silently, also describes D01.
disagreements.b_reason: It describes the slot grid and status text cleared for 900 ms with nothing in their place, and Next returning silently. That is D01's wait. It also restates D09's booking wait, but only one id can be given.

assertions.text: Precision after verification is at least 0.8
The reply puts the fixes in priority order and says what needs a person
